results.name: Foreign key specifies SET NULL on a NOT NULL column
results.description: Detects foreign keys declaring ON DELETE SET NULL or ON UPDATE SET NULL where all referencing child columns are NOT NULL, which guarantees a NOT NULL constraint failure when the referential action runs.
sampleViolations: primary: PUBLIC.CHILD foreign key FK_FIRST [FIRST_PARENT] specifies ON DELETE SET NULL, but column FIRST_PARENT is NOT NULL; a parent delete will fail the NOT NULL constraint.
primary: PUBLIC.CHILD foreign key FK_SECOND [SECOND_PARENT] specifies ON DELETE SET NULL, but column SECOND_PARENT is NOT NULL; a parent delete will fail the NOT NULL constraint.
primary: PUBLIC.CHILD foreign key FK_THIRD [THIRD_PARENT] specifies ON DELETE SET NULL, but column THIRD_PARENT is NOT NULL; a parent delete will fail the NOT NULL constraint.
results.recommendation: Align the foreign-key action with the column nullability: either make the referencing column(s) nullable so SET NULL can succeed, or change the referential action to RESTRICT, NO ACTION or CASCADE.
